title: Crash when enabling Transmitance and Subsurface Scatter on a BaseMaterial3D
body:
### Tested versions

 - Reproducible in: v4.8.dev (cb41ea115), 4.8.dev5 and 4.8.dev4
 - Not reproducible in: 4.8.dev3

Believe it was introduced in #109737

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev5 - Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors (1920x1080 @ 119.98 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 119.98 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (nvidia; 580.173.02) - AMD Ryzen 7 3700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.25 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

### Steps to reproduce

- Start from an empty scene
- Add any MeshInstance3D
- Add BaseMaterial3D
  - Enable Subsurface Scatter
  - Enable Transmittance

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32117446/mrp.zip) - Open and enable transmittance to cause the crash
